failed4 findings

4 of 4 semantic intents assessed · 16 documents selected

Versioned members are deleted without modeling their removalThe fetched Evolving APIs guidance requires versioned removal through `@removed`. Direct deletion rewrites the already existing 2026-12-06 projection instead of recording an evolution boundary.
Affected intents (4)
Remove NFS file item metadata and specialized item modelsRemove NFS directory-list metadata, item groups, and include optionsRemove NFS ownership and mode metadataRemove specialized NFS file type values
failed

Expected

Use `@removed` with the version where an existing model, property, operation, or service value is removed so earlier API-version projections retain the declaration.

Evolving APIs — Adding and removing API elements
You can add new models, properties, or operations in a specific version and all subsequent versions using the `@added` decorator. To remove models, properties, or operations starting from a specific version, use the `@removed` decorator.

Actual

The change deletes declarations marked `@added(Versions.v2026_12_06)` directly while continuing to compare and emit the existing stable 2026-12-06 API version.
